title: Lateness · noun
subtitle: 「遲到／延誤／晚到／不準時」，究竟是哪一種 lateness？
description: 「遲到／延誤／晚到／不準時」，究竟是哪一種 lateness？

words.note: Tardiness 特別指人未能準時到達、上班、上課或赴約，常見於學校、工作與出勤管理。
words.example: Repeated tardiness may lead to disciplinary action.

exercises.original: The school has introduced a policy to reduce student lateness.
exercises.zh: 學校推出政策，以減少學生遲到。
exercises.upgrade: tardiness · 遲到；不準時

options.explanation: 本題的決定性線索是 students failing to arrive on time；這裡需要的是「人的遲到／不準時」，所以 tardiness 最精確。
常見於 train, flight, project, process, delivery 等事件或程序延誤。 本題的決定性線索是 students failing to arrive on time；這裡需要的是「人的遲到／不準時」。因此 delay 雖都與 lateness 有關，但時間問題的類型並不最吻合。
最日常、最透明，直接描述某人／某事未按時出現。 本題的決定性線索是 students failing to arrive on time；這裡需要的是「人的遲到／不準時」。因此 being late 雖都與 lateness 有關，但時間問題的類型並不最吻合。
強調一次具體的晚到事件，常與 speaker, coach, delivery 搭配。 本題的決定性線索是 students failing to arrive on time；這裡需要的是「人的遲到／不準時」。因此 late arrival 雖都與 lateness 有關，但時間問題的類型並不最吻合。
較抽象、較正式，強調反覆性的缺乏守時。 本題的決定性線索是 students failing to arrive on time；這裡需要的是「人的遲到／不準時」。因此 unpunctuality 雖都與 lateness 有關，但時間問題的類型並不最吻合。
只適合 project/process/construction 等進度落後，不適合個人赴約。 本題的決定性線索是 students failing to arrive on time；這裡需要的是「人的遲到／不準時」。因此 behind-schedule status 雖都與 lateness 有關，但時間問題的類型並不最吻合。

falseSynonyms.zh: tardiness 特別常指人不準時；lateness 範圍更廣，也可指火車、項目、程序晚了。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Repeated tardiness may lead to a warning. The train's lateness caused missed connections.

falseSynonyms.zh: delay 強調事件或程序比原定時間晚；人的習慣性遲到更自然叫 tardiness / unpunctuality。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON There was a delay in processing the form. His tardiness became a problem.

falseSynonyms.zh: late arrival 是一次具體晚到事件；lateness 可描述一般狀態或反覆行為。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The late arrival of the speaker delayed the session. Her lateness has become frequent.

falseSynonyms.zh: unpunctuality 更像一種習慣性特徵；一次遲到通常不用這個抽象詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Persistent unpunctuality affects trust. His lateness today was caused by traffic.

falseSynonyms.zh: postponement 是有人把活動正式改到較後時間；lateness 是原定事情本身晚了。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The meeting was postponed until Friday. The meeting started late.

falseSynonyms.zh: cancellation 是取消，不是遲到或延誤。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The flight was cancelled. The flight was delayed.

falseSynonyms.zh: absence 是沒有出現；lateness 是出現了但太晚。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Her absence was unexplained. Her lateness was caused by traffic.

falseSynonyms.zh: lateness 是名詞；late 主要是形容詞／副詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON His lateness was noted. He arrived late.
